data.action: 俯身扫弦，主音吉他狂飙
data.camera: three quarter view, from below, cowboy shot
data.description: 音律联觉音乐会主舞台，激光与干冰烟雾中，主音吉他手陈怀抱赤红电吉他俯身扫弦，赤龙图腾在追光灯下灼灼发亮——「今晚的规矩只有一条——把音量开到最大！」
data.lighting: 一束暖白追光从舞台右侧扫过琴弦和红袖，烟幕里的细红激光拉出后景
data.promptProse: At the lip of the stage Ch’en leans into an emphatic downstroke, her right hand moving just above the pickups while the left curls around the frets of her red electric guitar. The low three-quarter view keeps the headstock, both hands and the motion of the red sleeve panel in frame. A floor monitor sits just ahead of her boots and a guitar lead runs back to stacked amplifiers. Over her shoulder, a red dragon emblem glows against the black stage drape. A warm spotlight lights the strings and the sleeve as fine red lasers pass through the haze behind her.
data.title: 陈 · 音律联觉舞台
data.animaCaption: She bends over the full length of the red guitar, one hand raking the strings above the pickups and the other pressing the frets. A wedge monitor sits on the stage edge, with speaker stacks behind her in the red laser haze.
